title: Hummus vegetable wrap
steps: Rinse the chickpeas and blend them with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, salt, oil and 2–3 tbsp water until smooth.
Slice the cucumber and tomato, wash and dry the lettuce.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan.
Spread the hummus over the tortillas, top with lettuce, cucumber and tomato, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
